title: studio(flow canvas): adding a node is inconsistent — toolbar Add node creates a parallel branch, edge "+" and Add connected node insert create_record without asking, and the Node Type select has no notify
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Studio flow designer on a writable package: each of the three ways to add a node misbehaves.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

- Toolbar **Add node** (with the node palette) attaches the new node as a second branch from Start: `start→end` and `start→notify`, the new node connected to nothing after it.
- The edge **"+" (Insert node here)** and **Add connected node** insert a `create_record` node without asking for a type, placed at the midpoint so it overlaps the Start card.
- The inspector's **Node Type** select cannot turn that node into a Notify: `notify` is not in the list, which also shows raw names (`http_request`, `connector_action`, `try_catch`).

## Where it comes from (read in source)

`insertOnEdge(edge, type = 'create_record')` in `FlowCanvas.tsx` defaults the type; `FLOW_NODE_TYPE_OPTIONS` in `inspectors/flow-node-config.ts` omits `notify` while the palette offers it.

## Expected

All three entry points open the same grouped palette; the new node is inserted into the path and laid out; Node Type uses the palette's list and display names.

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Route edge-insert and add-connected through the palette, auto-layout after insert, and derive the type select from the palette's registry.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.
